subject: Re: Kickoff: DPOK fine-tuning for the image-gen stack
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Tereza leads the RL training loop and reward integration, Rosa owns the multi-GPU scaling work, Chiara the eval harness plumbing and demo packaging.

Compute reality check: policy batch size 4 fits a single A100, but the moment we go multi-GPU the whole UNet has to be shared and we drop to batch 2 per accelerator — so multi-prompt training at demo quality is 32-48 GPUs for a couple of weeks. Q2 we can squeeze out of titan best-effort. The Q3 scale-up (full prompt distribution plus reward-model refresh cycles) needs its own funding: Idris has verbally earmarked $180k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-85 for this project — confirmed to me by phone Friday, paperwork to follow at Q3 planning. I'm planning the Q3 run rate against that line.

One dependency: our accelerate/torch_xla version pin is fragile (known issue in the release), Rosa is baking a fixed container image.

Alina
